$schema: Fusion Wheel catalog. May be enriched by scripts/sync-parts.mjs.

wheels.name: Storm
wheels.info: Three protruding curved blades with widely spread mass. Smash-attack profile. Used by Storm Pegasus.

wheels.name: Lightning
wheels.info: Aggressive sloped edges with sharp protrusions, built for left-spin smash. Used by Lightning L-Drago.

wheels.name: Rock
wheels.info: Heavy wheel with serrated edges. Defensive mass with rebounding contact. Used by Rock Leone and Rock Aries.

wheels.name: Flame
wheels.info: Lightweight, evenly distributed mass. Favors stamina configurations. Used by Flame Sagittario.

wheels.name: Earth
wheels.info: Wide, evenly massed wheel. Versatile across balance and defense builds. Used by Earth Eagle and Earth Virgo.

wheels.name: Dark
wheels.info: Compact wheel with two long horns. Aggressive defense profile. Used by Dark Bull.

wheels.name: Burn
wheels.info: Heavy disc with thick walls. Stamina-leaning. Used by Burn Fireblaze.

wheels.name: Galaxy
wheels.info: Multi-layered wheel with sharp protrusions. High attack power. Used by Galaxy Pegasus.

wheels.name: Cyber
wheels.info: Mid-weight wheel with mechanical-looking ridges. Attack-focused. Used by Cyber Pegasus.

wheels.name: Counter
wheels.info: Curved-edge wheel with counter-attack geometry. Defense-attack hybrid. Used by Counter Leone.

wheels.name: Meteo
wheels.info: Reinforced left-spin wheel. Iconic for spin-stealing attacks. Used by Meteo L-Drago.

wheels.name: Hades
wheels.info: Three-headed dog motif with massive mass. Defense-beast profile. Used by Hades Kerbecs (a.k.a. Hell Kerbecs).

wheels.name: Ray
wheels.info: Compact, rounded wheel for balanced attack. Mid-tier attack profile. Used by Ray Striker.

wheels.name: Vulcan
wheels.info: Sharp-edged wheel with hammer-like protrusions. Strong defense. Used by Vulcan Horuseus.

wheels.name: Gravity
wheels.info: Wide, dense wheel optimized for stable spin. Defense fortress. Used by Gravity Perseus.

wheels.name: Poison
wheels.info: Coiled snake design with whip-edge for trick attacks. Stamina with menace. Used by Poison Serpent.

wheels.name: Cosmic
wheels.info: 4D-era wheel with detachable layers — apex attack power. Used by Big Bang Pegasis.

wheels.name: Phantom
wheels.info: 4D-era wheel with smooth, low-friction shape. Apex stamina. Used by Phantom Orion.

wheels.name: Diablo
wheels.info: 4D-era wheel — heaviest of MFB, capable of either spin direction. Used by Diablo Nemesis.

wheels.name: Variares
wheels.info: 4D-era wheel with shifting geometry mid-battle. Mode-change attacker. Used by Variares.

wheels.name: Fang
wheels.info: 4D-era wheel with predator-fang protrusions. Maximum defense. Used by Fang Leone.
